14:2: This shall be the law regarding the one who is ‘confined’ [the person with tzoraas]
on the day of his purification,
he shall be brought to the kohein.
14:3: and behold! the skin-eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] has healed from the one who is ‘confined’ [the person with tzoraas].
14:4: to take for the person undergoing purification two live, pure [kosher] birds,
14:6: [As for] the living bird, he shall take it;
and the cedar wood, the colored [crimson] thread and the hyssop
and immerse them and the live bird in the blood of the slaughtered bird,
14:7: He shall sprinkle on the person undergoing purification from the ‘confinement’ [tzoraas], seven times
and make him pure; and send the live bird into the open field.
14:12: The kohein shall take one lamb and bring it as a guilt-offering, and (with) the log of oil
and lift them up as an uplifted-offering before Adonoy.
14:14: The kohein shall take from the blood of the guilt-offering
it on the upper part of the right ear of the person being purified,
and on the thumb of his right hand
and on the big toe of his right foot.
14:17: From the remaining oil that is on his palm, the kohein shall put on the upper part of the right ear of the person being purified,
and on the thumb of his right hand,
and on the big toe of his right foot;
on [over] the blood of the guilt-offering.
14:21: If he is poor and his means are not sufficient,
he shall take one lamb as a guilt-offering, for an uplifted-offering to atone for him
and one tenth fine flour mixed with oil, as a meal-offering and a log of oil.
14:24: The kohein shall take the guilt-offering sheep and the log of oil
and the kohein shall lift them up as an uplifted-offering before Adonoy.
14:25: He shall slaughter the guilt-offering lamb.
The kohein shall take some blood of the guilt-offering
and put it on the upper part of the right ear of the person undergoing purification,
and on the thumb of his right hand
and the big toe of his right foot.
14:28: The kohein shall put some of the oil that is on his palm, on the upper part of the right ear of the person undergoing purification,
and on the thumb of his right hand
and on the big toe of his right foot,
on the place of the blood of the guilt-offering.
14:32: of whoever has the skin-eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas]
whose means are not sufficient in his purification.
14:34: When you will come into the land of Canaan
that I will give to you for a possession,
and I shall put the eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas]
in the house of the land of your possession.
14:37: He shall see the eruption and behold! The eruption is in the walls of the house;
and they appear to be lower than the [surface of] the wall.
14:39: The kohein shall return on the seventh day
and shall see; and behold! the eruption has increased in the walls of the house.
14:44: and see; and behold! the eruption has increased in the house;
a ‘confinement’ of loss [prickly tzoraas] is in the house, it is impure.
14:48: If the kohein shall come and see; and behold! the eruption did not increase in the house
the kohein shall pronounce the house [to be] pure,
for the eruption has been healed.
14:49: He shall take, to purify the house, two birds,
14:51: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the colored [crimson] thread and the live bird
and immerse them in the blood of the slaughtered bird
and sprinkle the house seven times.
14:52: with the blood of the bird,
and with the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the colored [crimson] thread.
14:54: for all the eruptions of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] and for the nesek.
14:55: For ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] of the garment and of the house.
14:56: For the deep spot white as wool, for the removed spot that is nearly as white and for the spot white as snow.
14:57: To teach [the law] of the day of becoming impure and of the day of becoming pure;
15:19: When a woman has a discharge
[and] the discharge will be blood in her body,
for seven days she will be in [the state of] her ‘separation’.
Anyone who touches her will be impure until the evening.
15:20: Everything that she sleeps on, during her ‘separation’, will become impure
and everything that she sits on will be impure.
15:24: If a man will lie conjugally with her, her ‘separation’ will be on him
and he is impure for seven days.
Anything used for sleeping — if he should sleep on it — it will be impure.
15:25: When a woman discharges her blood-flow, many days outside her period of ‘separation’,
or if it flows after her ‘separation’,
all the days of her discharge-impurity shall be as her days of ‘separation’; she is impure.
15:26: Anything used for sleeping upon which she will lie [on] any of her discharge-impurity-days,
as the bed of her ‘separation’ it shall be to her.
Every vessel upon which she sits
15:33: For the woman who is impure during her period of separation
and for one who has a discharge
for a male and for a female;
and for the man that will lie conjugally with an impure woman.
